bio.text: Katy Padilla Stout is the Democratic nominee in Texas's 23rd Congressional District, according to the San Antonio Report, which describes her as a San Antonio attorney who serves on the Bexar County Child Welfare Board and previously taught elementary school in Northside ISD.

In a candidate questionnaire for the San Antonio Report, she said she was born and raised in San Antonio, earned a B.S. in Education from UT-Austin in 2007 and a J.D. from South Texas College of Law in 2013, and has served on the Child Welfare Board since 2017.
She said she lives in Leon Springs with her husband, Austin, and their four children.

sources.title: Katy Padilla Stout | 2026 candidate for Texas' 23rd Congressional District
